propositions: Provider-prefixed model references (anthropic:claude-opus, openai:gpt-5.4) fail LookupError in genai_prices.calc_price whereas bare model names resolve correctly
Bedrock prefix form resolves by coincidence; Anthropic and OpenAI prefix forms silently drop to unpriced, creating asymmetric cost comparison bias in provider matrices
Caught LookupError at usage_log.py:429 silently suppresses unpriced rows without warning, making malformed ids indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models

Provider-qualified ids must be translated to genai-prices-resolvable form via registry membership decision, not prefix sniffing, because versioned AWS ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 would break on naive colon-split
Unpriced rows must remain best-effort and never break summarize, but genuinely unknown models must be visibly distinguishable from mis-formatted ids in output
